_comment: Labelled consulting and engineering prompts used to measure the classifier. 'light' = should get a lighter-setup tip on a heavy setup (trivial or routine). 'heavy' = genuinely complex: must never be called light, and ideally classed complex so an upgrade tip can fire on a light setup. 'neutral' = ambiguous everyday asks: must never be called light. Add real (anonymised) prompts from your firm here.
